guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: jangly acoustic-electric folk rock with bright clean electric accents
tone.profile: jangly acoustic-electric folk rock with bright clean electric accents
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain using a Comp for strumming dynamics, followed by the US Deluxe amp model to emulate clear, articulate electric accents suitable for folk-rock textures. Minimal effects are used to maintain clarity.
corrections: keep electric parts subtle and clean
